summary: HTTP(S) endpoint the solver POSTs status events to.
constraints: Must be a valid HTTP(S) URL.
businessRules: url defines: Specify your webhook URL. Please note only HTTP(s) are supported. The URL provided here will be called by the optimization service using a HTTP POST method along with event payload.
Must stay consistent with: options.webhook.events. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
